content.short: Crypto/stablecoin card, wallet and payout product.
content.description: RedotPay is a Hong Kong-based crypto payments company that lets people spend stablecoins and crypto like cash at more than 130 million merchants through Visa cards. Users hold assets such as USDT, USDC, BTC, ETH, and SOL in the RedotPay wallet and spend directly via physical or virtual cards, with the platform converting crypto to fiat at the point of sale. Deposits are supported across networks including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Arbitrum, and Polygon, and RedotPay has added dedicated products like a Solana card for spending SOL-ecosystem tokens without bridging. Serving both consumers and businesses globally, RedotPay also offers payouts, positioning itself as an everyday crypto spending and cross-border payments product that bridges digital assets and the traditional card network.
